name: Matheus Camilo
event: UFC Fight Night: Allen vs. Duncan
summary: A 25-year-old Nova Uniao wrestler: 11-4. Lost a 29-28 decision to Jai Herbert in October 2026 after taking him down twice; faded badly in round 3. Before that, knocked out Nazim Sadykhov in 91 seconds.

how_they_fight.Striking: Low UFC volume (about 1.7 significant strikes a minute) but showed power against Sadykhov.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Wrestling-heavy: chains clinch and bodylock takedowns and reaches dominant positions, but struggles to hold them (lost mount to Herbert in round 2); was submitted by Gabriel Green in 2025.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Tired visibly in round 3 against Herbert: slower, head movement gone, missed both late shots. Treat his 15-minute cardio as a question.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Says he respects Herbert's experience (Yahoo Sports).
